Atomic: subject mask/VOS. Uses draft-aware mask_tracking_matting when --ref +
--seg-id or an active editor session is available; otherwise falls back to media
object-matting-track with --input.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h, --help                            Print this help message and exit
      --input TEXT                      Source video file path.
      --ref TEXT                        Draft ref used as in-memory segment context.
      --seg-id TEXT                     Target video segment id for draft-aware mask tracking.
      --target-object-desc TEXT         SAM3 English physical target phrase.
      --seed-mask-rle-json TEXT         Optional seed mask RLE JSON (@file).
      --seed-time TEXT                  Seed frame time (file-local or segment-local, e.g. 1200ms).
      --output-dir TEXT REQUIRED        Directory for mask artifacts.
      --channel <online|test|local_test> 
                                        Material request channel. Use `test` or `local_test` for internal
                                        test resources.
  -v, --version                         Show version information and exit.
      --jq TEXT                         Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                                        .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                                        the full schema envelope.

WORKFLOW
  build-runtime-manifest  strictly resolves package recipe steps into a standard runtime_data_manifest.
  track-subject-mask / encode-subject-alpha / track-plane-quad are the atomic steps it dispatches; they can also be called directly.

NOTE
  Produces subject_alpha.v1 / subject_transform.v1 / plane_quad.v1 with time_base=draft_us (frame time_us rebased to 0). Apply via `draft effect add --type motiongraph --runtime-data-manifest <manifest>`.
